title: daucus azoricus
intro: Daucus azoricus, commonly known as Azores carrot, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Daucus azoricus include its use in traditional medicine to alleviate digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, as well as its potential to support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Daucus azoricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
